title: Servidor - EC2 (host metrics)
description: CPU, RAM, swap, ancho de banda, disco y temperatura de la instancia (OpenTelemetry Collector)

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, ROUND(100 * (1 - AVG(value)), 2) AS y_axis_1 FROM "system_cpu_utilization" WHERE state = 'idle' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1

panels.title: CPU por estado (%) — "steal" alto = sin créditos de CPU en t3

queries.query: SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, state AS breakdown_1, ROUND(100 * AVG(value), 2) AS y_axis_1 FROM "system_cpu_utilization" WHERE state <> 'idle' GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, ROUND(100 * AVG(value), 2) AS y_axis_1 FROM "system_memory_utilization" WHERE state = 'used' GROUP BY x_axis_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, state AS breakdown_1, AVG(value) AS y_axis_1 FROM "system_memory_usage" GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT histogram(_timestamp) AS x_axis_1, mountpoint AS breakdown_1, ROUND(100 * MAX(value), 2) AS y_axis_1 FROM "system_filesystem_utilization" GROUP BY x_axis_1, breakdown_1 ORDER BY x_axis_1
SELECT * FROM "host_temperature" ORDER BY _timestamp DESC LIMIT 20
